name: Exact-in/exact-out arbitrage
mission: Explota una inconsistencia de precio, ruta, comisión o liquidez spot on-chain mediante Exact-in/exact-out arbitrage.

specific_note: Evaluate both protocol exact-in and exact-out constraints; do not approximate exact-out by inverse exact-in.
